calls.arg: git -C session-memory merge --ff-only origin/main 2>&1 | tail -2; cd pandoscope && git status -sb | head -5 && git rev-parse HEAD && git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD && cat AGENTS.md | head -150
cd /home/user/pandoscope && git rev-parse HEAD && git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD

git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/pandoscope/cli.py src/pandoscope/reinset/hooks.py src/pandoscope/reinset/install.py src/pandoscope/reinset/receive.py src/pandoscope/reinset/render.py src/pandoscope/reinset/profiles src/pandoscope/reinset/tasks src/pandoscope/reinset/compose.py .claude-plugin npm pyproject.toml src/pandoscope/__init__.py; cat -n src/pandoscope/reinset/profiles/implementer.yml sr
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- README.md; git show origin/main:src/pandoscope/reinset/tasks/implementer.md.j2; git show origin/main:src/pandoscope/reinset/profiles/implementer.yml

git grep -n -i "general" -- . ':!uv.lock' | grep -v "^tests/" | head -40; echo ---; git grep -n "name_code\|IMPLEMENTER_PASSES\|0\.4\.0\|repo-codes\|pr<n>\|-pr{" | head -20; echo ---; ls src/pandoscope/reinset/profiles src/pandoscope/reinset/tasks; echo; git grep -n -i "probe\|orchestrator" -- src README.md | head -40; echo ---; git grep -n "xfail" -- tests | head

sed -n 215,260p tests/unit/reinset/test_order.py; cat -n src/pandoscope/reinset/render.py | sed -n 26,90p; cat src/pandoscope/reinset/profiles/__init__.py 2>/dev/null | head -80 || ls src/pandoscope/reinset; sed -n 150,165p README.md

git diff origin/main...HEAD -- tests/unit/reinset/test_implement.py tests/unit/test_cli_shortcodes.py tests/unit/reinset/test_compose.py tests/unit/reinset/test_render.py tests/unit/reinset/test_profiles.py | grep -v "^ " | head -520

git grep -n "implement-<model\|implement-opus\|implement-«model\|review-<pass>-<model_tier>-pr\|tasks/implementer.md" -- . ':!tests' | head; ls; git diff origin/main...HEAD -- tests/unit/reinset/test_order.py tests/unit/test_cli_order.py tests/unit/reinset/test_hydrate.py tests/unit/reinset/test_hooks.py tests/unit/reinset/test_install.py tests/unit/reinset/conftest.py | grep "^[+-]" | cut -c1-170
